purpose: Positive fixture of the released flat Session 50 (tag v0.14.5) that a Web Save Session wrote with the Linear wrap length kept as a GUI-unmanaged preserved override (PD-OI-009) in the Linear slice's draft, modes.linear.config.unmanagedConfigOverrides['canvas.linear.wrap_length']. Load moves it into the drawing's Wrap Rows value, form.linear_wrap_length (PD-OI-113; adoptPromotedPreservedOverrides in gbdraw/web/js/services/session-request.js).
route: The v0.14.5 Python API writes a Linear Session whose request carries config_overrides {'canvas.linear.wrap_length': 5000}; the v0.14.5 Web app loads it (the path is not a GUI setting there, so it becomes a preserved override) and Save Session writes it in the Linear slice's draft.
pythonWriter: save_session_document(path, LinearDiagramRequest(records=(RecordInput(source=GenBankInputSource('tests/test_inputs/HmmtDNA.gbk')),), options=LinearDiagramOptions(config_overrides={'canvas.linear.wrap_length': 5000})), title='wrap-length-preserved'), run with python -P from the root of `git archive v0.14.5` (gbdraw on sys.path)
webWriter: in Node, from the root of the same tree: the tag's gbdraw/web/js/services/config.js importSession (confirmLoadRepairs: acceptNodeFeatureRecoveryRow) then exportSession('wrap-length-preserved'), with the tag's tests/web/helpers/session-import-node.mjs, tests/web/fake-svg-dom.mjs, tests/web/helpers/session-caller.mjs and the unmanaged-override validator of tests/web/session-cli-compatibility.test.mjs (validateWebConfigOverrides of tests/web/helpers/python-evaluator.mjs)
